title: Fix concurrent group access to prevent NullPointerException

golden_comments.comment: Returning null from getSubGroupsCount() violates the GroupModel contract (Javadoc says it never returns null) and may lead to NPEs in callers that expect a non-null count.
The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.
